headline: Video: US Dollar Index Strengthens, Rupiah Could Slump to Rp18,300 per USD
summary: A video report says the US dollar index is strengthening and the rupiah could fall to Rp18,300 per US dollar. The item focuses on pressure on the Indonesian currency.
why: The US dollar index measures the greenback against major currencies. A stronger dollar typically weighs on emerging-market currencies such as the rupiah.
original_headline: Video: Indeks Dolar AS Menguat, Rupiah Bisa Anjlok ke Rp18.300 per USD
